text:
maria: Heads up—canary rollout for the routing feature in eu-west-1 hit a 403 when trying to create the canary job. Deploys are failing fast.

deploy-bot: [alert] canary:create failed for service-account=redwood-canary-sa, error=403 permission denied (operation=create.canary)

joel: Oof. Can you paste the minimal error output? Is it a cloud IAM 403 or our authz service returning 403?

maria: Here's the kube error from the agent: ```
Error from server (Forbidden): error when creating "/tmp/canary.yaml": roles.rbac.authorization.k8s.io "ops-deployer" is forbidden: user "system:serviceaccount:infra:redwood-canary-sa" cannot create resource "roles" in API group "rbac.authorization.k8s.io" at the cluster scope
```

anika: That looks like our RBAC mapping didn't add the new "canary.launch" permission to ops-deployer. We merged a refactor yesterday (PR #3421) that flattened role->capabilities and I think one mapping got dropped.

kevin: FWIW the rollout gating flow also hits the internal authz service (authz.redwood) which now validates a KMS-signed assertion from the deployment agent. If the KMS audit isn't present, authz rejects the request. Could be two symptoms stacking.

shreya: I just checked KMS audit logs for the canary key; I'm not seeing any sign of the agent retrieving a key during the failed attempts. Ran: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=cloud_kms_crypto_key AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"svc-redwood-canary@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"" --limit 20` and got no matches.

joel: So either the agent failed to call KMS (network/credentials) or the KMS call succeeded but audit entries weren't delivered due to logging sink bug. Any recent infra changes?

maria: No infra deploys from our side during that timespan. The agent logs show a 401 from the KMS client lib about missing metadata token right before the kube error.

anika: Confirmed in PR diff: the capability bundle `capabilities/canary.json` had the key `canary.launch: true` removed by accident. That would make ops-deployer not get the right aggregated role, causing the RBAC 403 even if KMS were fine. I'll repush a fix. :bug:

kevin: Good catch. For the KMS audit part, I'll open a follow-up with infra to verify the logging sink and whether any recent service account role changes could block audit export.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1442 — "Canary rollout 403 in eu-west-1". Assigned to eng-sre and eng-security.

joel: Short-term mitigation: we can patch ops-deployer to explicitly include `canary.launch` until the refactor mapping is fixed. Deploy a one-line role patch and retry canary. Also, add a smoke test that performs a KMS read to assert audit emission.

maria: Patching now, applying this small YAML: ```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: ops-deployer
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods"]
  verbs: ["create", "get"]
- apiGroups: ["rbac.authorization.k8s.io"]
  resources: ["roles"]
  verbs: ["create"]
  # explicit canary capability flag for backward compat
  # (temporary)
```
Applied and re-triggering the canary.

deploy-bot: [info] canary:create accepted, queuing job id=canary-1783456820

maria: Canary started and initial checks passing. Will let it run through the A/B window and monitor trace/error budgets. :thumbsup:

anika: I'll open a follow-up PR to restore the capability bundle and add a unit test that asserts all capabilities in the refactor map to at least one role. Also adding an integration test that simulates missing KMS audit and ensures authz fails with a clear diagnostic.

kevin: I'll file infra ticket to verify KMS logging sink and add alerting if KMS calls stop emitting audit entries for service accounts used by agents.

shreya: For the vuln triage side: we should treat accidental capability removal as a high-risk regression. Adding notes to the incident: audit trail for PRs touching capability bundles, require codeowner signoffs for role/capability changes.

joel: Agreed. After this stabilizes, let's do a quick postmortem with remediation: (1) revert mapping bug, (2) add tests, (3) infra KMS audit check, (4) codeowner gating. I'll ping @oncall for PM scheduling.

maria: Thanks all. Keeping the thread updated if anything changes.
